```{=html}
<style>
.w135-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w135-dd ol.w135-list { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; padding: 0; counter-reset: w135; }
.w135-dd .w135-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; counter-increment: w135;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 6px 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
}
.w135-dd .w135-item::before {
  content: counter(w135); font-weight: 700; min-width: 1.5em; text-align: center;
  color: #d81e2e;
}
.w135-dd .w135-item.w135-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w135-dd .w135-item.w135-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; }
.w135-dd .w135-text { flex: 1; }
.w135-dd .w135-btns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.w135-dd .w135-btns button, .w135-dd .w135-controls button {
  padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.w135-dd .w135-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w135-dd .w135-controls button { padding: 5px 14px; }
.w135-dd .w135-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w135-dd .w135-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w135-dd .w135-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w135-dd .w135-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w135-dd .w135-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w135-dd iw" id="w135-dd">
  <ol class="w135-list" aria-label="steps to put in order"></ol>
  <div class="w135-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w135-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w135-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w135-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w135-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w135-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w135-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    The method runs: name the threat, judge the risk, choose the control that fits,
    state why, and add the next layer, because no single control is sufficient. A
    control can only be chosen once the threat and its risk are understood — the
    course has applied this eleven times to one service, and it transfers to any
    other — see <a href="#sec-13-argument">the section on the argument</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w135-dd');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w135-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w135-msg');
  // pos = correct position (1-based); INITIAL = fixed scrambled starting order.
  const STEPS = [
    { pos: 1, text: 'Name the threat' },
    { pos: 2, text: 'Judge the risk' },
    { pos: 3, text: 'Choose the control that fits' },
    { pos: 4, text: 'State why' },
    { pos: 5, text: 'Add the next layer, because no single control is sufficient' }
  ];
  const INITIAL = [3, 5, 1, 4, 2]; // pos values in starting display order
  let dragEl = null;

  function clearMarks() {
    list.querySelectorAll('.w135-item').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('w135-right', 'w135-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w135-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeItem(step) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'w135-item';
    li.dataset.pos = step.pos;
    li.draggable = true;
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'w135-text';
    span.textContent = step.text;
    const btns = document.createElement('span');
    btns.className = 'w135-btns';
    const up = document.createElement('button');
    up.type = 'button'; up.className = 'w135-up'; up.textContent = '▲';
    up.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move up');
    up.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (li.previousElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(li, li.previousElementSibling); clearMarks(); }
    });
    const down = document.createElement('button');
    down.type = 'button'; down.className = 'w135-down'; down.textContent = '▼';
    down.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move down');
    down.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (li.nextElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(li.nextElementSibling, li); clearMarks(); }
    });
    btns.appendChild(up); btns.appendChild(down);
    li.appendChild(span); li.appendChild(btns);
    li.addEventListener('dragstart', e => { dragEl = li; e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', step.pos); });
    li.addEventListener('dragend', () => { dragEl = null; });
    return li;
  }
  list.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!dragEl) return;
    const li = e.target.closest('.w135-item');
    if (!li || li === dragEl) return;
    const r = li.getBoundingClientRect();
    const before = (e.clientY - r.top) < r.height / 2;
    list.insertBefore(dragEl, before ? li : li.nextSibling);
    clearMarks();
  });
  list.addEventListener('drop', e => e.preventDefault());
  function build() {
    list.textContent = '';
    INITIAL.forEach(p => list.appendChild(makeItem(STEPS.find(s => s.pos === p))));
  }
  root.querySelector('.w135-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let wrong = 0;
    [...list.querySelectorAll('.w135-item')].forEach((li, i) => {
      li.classList.remove('w135-right', 'w135-wrong');
      if (Number(li.dataset.pos) === i + 1) { li.classList.add('w135-right'); }
      else { li.classList.add('w135-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — that is the method, applied eleven times to one service.'; msg.className = 'w135-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + wrong + ' step(s) out of place. What must be understood before a control can fit?'; msg.className = 'w135-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w135-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...list.children].sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.pos) - Number(b.dataset.pos))
      .forEach(li => list.appendChild(li));
    clearMarks();
    [...list.children].forEach(li => li.classList.add('w135-right'));
    root.querySelector('.w135-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w135-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w135-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    build(); clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w135-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  build();
})();
</script>
```
